items.title: Secure code at scale with system signed commits and project/workspace level enforcement
items.summary: Workspace- and project-level signed commit enforcement will allow admins to require valid, verifiable signatures across repositories in their scope. Bitbucket will reject commits that are unsigned or whose where signatures cannot be validated, helping teams apply their security policy consistently at scale. This is a Premium feature and is only available to workspaces on Premium […]The post Secure code at scale with system signed commits and project/workspace level enforcement appeared first on Inside Atlassian.
